headline: ECO Bloc Adopts Strategic Economic Cooperation Framework Through 2035
summary: Member states of the Economic Cooperation Organization, meeting in Tashkent, adopted a strategic framework for regional trade, transport, and economic cooperation spanning Central and South Asia through 2035.
why: The 10-member ECO bloc connects landlocked Central Asian nations to seaport networks across Pakistan and Turkey, unlocking strategic regional trade corridors.

impacts.name: Uzbekistan
impacts.why: Adopting the 2035 framework enhances transit infrastructure and trade flows across member economies.
